extras: Fully bundled with no network access at runtime.
intentEvidence: A PDF and EPUB reader for Obsidian that displays two-page spreads the way a printed book does
problem: Obsidian's default PDF viewer scrolls one page at a time and lacks support for EPUB files or complex book layouts like right-to-left binding.
summary: BookView is a PDF and EPUB reader for Obsidian that displays two-page spreads, supports right-to-left binding, and includes an Acrobat-style cover page option.
